decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single storey rear extension would be acceptable due to its position, size, design and appearance and the positioning of extensions at neighbouring properties. The development would not harm the appearance of the area, or the neighbours living conditions and complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), and  H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow Adopted Unitary Development Plan 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey extension to house.
